provenance.builtDuring: Phase 3.8.3 (Real Presentation Output Rendering & Windows Display Verification) - rebuilt to package: (1) a Windows-only explicit resize nudge immediately after the display window is created, to force WebView2's initial paint (the best-supported explanation, from real Linux/WebKitGTK end-to-end reproduction, for a known Tauri/WRY/WebView2 defect class where a newly created secondary webview window does not paint its first frame until it receives a resize/redraw signal), and (2) permanent-in-code but development-only temporary diagnostic logging at 14 checkpoints along the full detect-approve-prepare-display path, routed through the existing log::info! macros and a new minimal log_display_diagnostic command, so a future real Windows failure can be root-caused directly from the log file instead of by further guessing
provenance.buildEnvironment: cross-compiled from Linux using rustup target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu, gcc-mingw-w64, and nsis (makensis) - identical toolchain to every prior phase, see docs/phase-3-4-windows-pilot.md for the original toolchain setup and docs/phase-3-8-3-presentation-display-rendering.md for what changed this phase
provenance.note: This artifact supersedes the Phase 3.8.2 installer (previously SHA-256 dedc7b2b89bafcb1598cab50beda2f951b802180f0c2806a1016f516e7154945) because this phase modified apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/presentation_display.rs (Windows-only resize nudge + checkpoint-1 log), apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs (checkpoints 5/6/13/14 logs + new log_display_diagnostic command), apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs (registers the new command), apps/desktop/src/lib/commands.ts (logDisplayDiagnostic wrapper), and apps/desktop/src/components/PresentationDisplay.tsx (calls the new wrapper at every reachable frontend checkpoint). Zero new database migrations, zero renderer changes, zero Bible/intelligence engine changes, zero event contract changes, zero capability changes - see docs/phase-3-8-3-presentation-display-rendering.md for the full architectural-safety diff. This is a freshly compiled build (`cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` via `tauri build`), not a copy of a prior artifact. A real defect in the diagnostic instrumentation itself was found and fixed during this phase's own Linux/Xvfb re-verification pass before this build: the app's log level is hardcoded to Info (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs), so the checkpoint calls were switched from log::debug! to log::info! - without this fix, none of the new diagnostic lines would ever have appeared in the log file the operator relies on, on Windows or anywhere else.

releaseCandidateStatement: This is the Phase 3.8.3 SOFTWARE RELEASE CANDIDATE for Windows x64 (Real Presentation Output Rendering & Windows Display Verification). It is a real, verifiable build artifact - not a placeholder, not a simulation, not a fabrication. See docs/phase-3-8-3-presentation-display-rendering.md for the full PASS/HOLD breakdown and final gate.
physicalHardwareStatement: Physical hardware qualification has NOT been performed in the build environment. This installer has not been installed, launched, or tested on any real Windows machine. No real microphone, no real Whisper transcription, no real second display/projector, and no real human operator workflow has been exercised against this build. Xvfb, simulated audio, virtual displays, automated tests, and cross-compilation success are Environment A/B evidence only and are never substituted for Environment C (real hardware) evidence anywhere in this project's documentation. The operator's own Phase 3.8.2 Windows testing (which reported the blank-display symptom this phase investigates) is real Environment C usage of the PRIOR (Phase 3.8.2) build, not of this rebuilt artifact - per this phase's own explicit instruction, that prior test is never converted into PASS evidence for this rebuild. The applied fix is the best-supported explanation given real Linux/WebKitGTK end-to-end reproduction (which found the entire pipeline correct, including under adversarial near-zero-delay timing) and a well-documented Windows/WebView2 defect class, but it has not been confirmed by direct reproduction on Windows because no physical Windows machine is available in this container.
githubReleaseStatus: NOT CONFIGURED - no .github/workflows directory exists in this repository, and no GitHub Release has been created for this artifact. This installer is available only via this repository's working tree (release/windows/), not via GitHub Releases or any CI/CD pipeline.
obtainingWithoutDeveloperTooling: The file at release/windows/Church Intelligence Platform_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe can be copied/transferred directly (e.g. via a git clone of this repository, a direct file download, or a USB drive) to the target Windows machine and run there. Running the installer on Windows requires none of: Claude Code, Rust, Cargo, Node.js, npm, or the CIP source tree - only the .exe file itself.
knownLimitations: UNSIGNED release candidate - Windows SmartScreen will show an 'unknown publisher' warning on first run
Cross-compiled from Linux, never launch-tested on real Windows hardware - Environment C remains not performed for THIS rebuilt artifact

The Windows-only resize-nudge fix is the best-supported remaining explanation for the blank-display symptom, not a confirmed root cause - it could not be directly reproduced or confirmed in this environment (no physical Windows machine, no WebView2 runtime available here)

The 14-checkpoint diagnostic logging is temporary, development-only instrumentation intended to be read directly from the log file (RUST_LOG is not required - checkpoints now log at Info level) if the display is still blank after this fix on real Windows hardware; it is not a permanent feature and should be removed once the real root cause is confirmed

Music Library is legitimately empty in a production build - no licensed production song dataset exists in this repository; Service Replay's default flow does not exercise Music Intelligence for this reason

The ground-up visual/UX redesign described aspirationally in the original Phase 3.8 spec was deliberately not attempted this phase either - scope remained limited to the specific rendering defect the operator reported
See docs/phase-3-8-3-presentation-display-rendering.md and pilot-evidence/3.8.3/ for the full Environment A/B/C evidence breakdown
